title: Red Hat Security Advisory: librabbitmq security update
description: A heap buffer overflow vulnerability exists in the librabbitmq client library's amqp_send_frame() function when serializing an oversized AMQP_FRAME_BODY. This flaw is identified as CVE-2026-61547 and affects Red Hat Enterprise Linux 8 packages of librabbitmq. The vulnerability could potentially lead to memory corruption issues.
